plugins.name: Goodreads
plugins.description: Searches Goodreads author profiles for biography, dates, website, portrait, and Goodreads ID.
plugins.networkDisclosure: Sends search queries (title, author, ISBN/ASIN, or identifiers as applicable) to www.goodreads.com. May download cover images from the same providers. No BookAtrium account credentials are transmitted.

plugins.name: DOCX Conversion Input
plugins.description: Reads Word (.docx) documents, including headings, tables, images, and footnotes, into the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation.

plugins.name: EPUB Conversion Input
plugins.description: Reads EPUB packages (OPF manifest, spine, and resources) into the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation.

plugins.name: FB2 Conversion Input
plugins.description: Reads FictionBook 2 (FB2) documents, including embedded binaries, into the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation.

plugins.name: HTML Conversion Input
plugins.description: Reads HTML/XHTML documents, sanitizing markup and importing local images, into the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation.

plugins.name: KEPUB Conversion Input
plugins.description: Reads Kobo KEPUB packages (EPUB structure with Kobo reader markup stripped) into the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation.

plugins.name: Kindle Conversion Input
plugins.description: Reads Kindle MOBI/AZW/AZW3/PRC/POBI books (clean-room Palm/MOBI parsing; DRM-protected files are rejected) into the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation.

plugins.name: PDF Conversion Input
plugins.description: Extracts per-page text from PDF documents into the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation.

plugins.name: TXT Conversion Input
plugins.description: Reads plain-text files, detecting chapter headings and paragraph boundaries, into the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation.

plugins.name: AZW3 Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a KF8 (AZW3) PalmDOC/MOBI container.

plugins.name: DOCX Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a minimal OOXML (.docx) document.

plugins.name: EPUB Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to an EPUB package (OPF manifest, spine, nav, and resources).

plugins.name: HTML Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a single HTML file plus a sibling resources folder.

plugins.name: KEPUB Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a Kobo KEPUB package (EPUB structure with Kobo reader markup injected).

plugins.name: LRF Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a BookAtrium-flavoured LRF (Sony BroadBand eBook) container.

plugins.name: MOBI Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a legacy MOBI7 PalmDOC/MOBI container.

plugins.name: OEB Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to an unpacked Open eBook (OEB) folder (content.opf, toc.ncx, Text/, Resources/).

plugins.name: PDF Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a paginated PDF document using Syncfusion Blink (Chromium). Requires the BookAtrium host Syncfusion Blink runtime 34.1.33 under Runtimes/Syncfusion/Blink/34.1.33/.

plugins.name: TXT Conversion Output
plugins.description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a word-wrapped plain-text file.

plugins.name: Core Book File Types
plugins.description: Standard ebook, document, comic archive, and audiobook file-type definitions.

plugins.name: Core Input Profiles
plugins.description: Standard EPUB, clean-reading, preserve-layout, and plain-text input profiles.

plugins.name: MP3 Audiobook Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads MP3 audiobook metadata from ID3v2 and ID3v1 tags, including title, authors, narrator, genre, description, date, duration, identifiers, and cover image.

plugins.name: M4B/M4A Audiobook Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads M4B and M4A audiobook metadata from MPEG-4 atoms, including title, authors, narrator, album, grouping, genre, description, date, duration, identifiers, and cover image.

plugins.name: DOCX Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads DOCX core/app/custom properties, authors, keywords, page counts, identifiers, Calibre-style custom metadata, and the first plausible embedded cover image.

plugins.name: ePub/KePub Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads OPF metadata, identifiers, authors, series, subjects, page data, and cover images from ePub and KePub files.

plugins.name: ExifTool Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Optional external metadata probe. Uses ExifTool when it is installed or bundled with the app, filling metadata gaps without replacing native readers.

plugins.name: FB2 Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads FictionBook 2 title/publish/document info, authors, translators, genres, series, identifiers, and embedded cover images.

plugins.name: HTML Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads meta tags, Dublin Core fields, legacy HTML comment metadata, series, identifiers, and local cover images referenced from HTML/XHTML files.

plugins.name: LIT Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Best-effort binary scan for Microsoft Reader (LIT) title, author, publisher, language, and identifier metadata.

plugins.name: LRF Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Best-effort binary scan for Sony BroadBand eBook (LRF) title, author, publisher, language, and identifier metadata.

plugins.name: LRX Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Parses the embedded LRF BookInfo/DocInfo XML from Sony LRX container files, with a best-effort binary scan fallback.

plugins.name: MOBI Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads MOBI, AZW, AZW3, PRC and POBI Palm database headers, MOBI title fields, EXTH authors/publisher/description/subjects/identifiers/language, and embedded cover records when present.

plugins.name: ODT Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads OpenDocument text metadata, authors, keywords, statistics, identifiers, Calibre-style user-defined metadata, and embedded cover images.

plugins.name: OPF Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads standalone OPF package metadata, identifiers, authors, series, subjects, page data, and linked cover images.

plugins.name: PDF Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads PDF document information, XMP metadata, identifiers, authors, keywords, dates, and page count.

plugins.name: RAR Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads RAR and CBR archive metadata, image counts, and stored ComicInfo.xml metadata when the XML entry is not compressed.

plugins.name: RTF Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads RTF info-block metadata, authors, subject/comments, keywords/categories, publisher fields, dates, identifiers, and estimated page counts.

plugins.name: Topaz Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Parses the embedded metadata block from Amazon Topaz (TPZ/AZW1) files, with a best-effort binary scan fallback.

plugins.name: ZIP Metadata Reader
plugins.description: Reads ZIP, CBZ, FBZ and HTMLZ archive metadata from ComicInfo.xml, OPF, FB2, or HTML files, and falls back to archive image counts and cover images.

plugins.name: Amazon US Kindle Store
plugins.description: Unofficial BookAtrium store plugin for searching Amazon.com Kindle listings and opening product pages in the user's browser.
plugins.networkDisclosure: Sends store search queries to www.amazon.com, amazon.com, m.media-amazon.com, images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com, images-eu.ssl-images-amazon.com and may open product pages in the user's browser. Does not perform purchases, logins, or downloads.

plugins.name: Demo Store
plugins.description: Deterministic offline catalogue for demonstrations and store-search UI testing.
plugins.networkDisclosure: Sends store search queries to provider endpoints declared by the plugin and may open product pages in the user's browser. Does not perform purchases, logins, or downloads.
